      "impact": 3,
      "evidence": [

      "asvs": [],
      "cwe": ["CWE-770"],
      "plainLanguage": "Someone could spam the assistant and burn through the paid AI budget so nobody else can use it.",

        "title": "Cap per-user and global model spend",
        "given": "an authenticated employee sends questions to the assistant",
        "when": "their request rate, token usage or the global spend passes a configured cap",
        "then": "further calls are refused with a clear message, the cap is enforced server-side, and operators are alerted"
      }
    }
